retrievalProfile.description: Produces a 1990s country-rock aesthetic featuring a male subject in textured clothing against a dark, industrial backdrop with high-contrast red display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male figure with a mullet hairstyle, wearing a textured metallic-sheen shirt and dark leather pants, leaning against a horizontal bar in a dark, wet industrial setting. The composition is anchored by a large, condensed red serif title at the top and loose, yellow handwritten text on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Red condensed header vs. dark desaturated background
Textured metallic shirt vs. matte industrial environment
Formal structured title vs. informal handwritten subtitle
Vertical subject posture vs. horizontal bar anchor
coreInvariants: Textured or metallic fabric on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-full shot, subject leaning forward slightly, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A horizontal yellow-toned bar cutting across the lower third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red header, moves down the subject's face and shirt, then follows the handwritten text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowy areas on the right side provide a canvas for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal and muted industrial greens/browns in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow/gold for the handwritten text and highlights on the shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value contrast on the subject's clothing and the primary text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and one primary accent color

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-condensed serif and loose cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Extremely tall x-height, minimal tracking, sharp slab-like serifs.
Subtitle: Irregular stroke width, slanted baseline, mimicking chalk or paint marker.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'R' in the header has a high-waisted leg.
The 'f' in the script has an elongated, expressive tail.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid, architectural serif with fluid, messy handwriting.
graphicDevices: Horizontal bar as a compositional divider

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, high-impact serif look of the header.
Captures the informal, hand-painted feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, dark industrial scene with a man in a metallic-textured shirt leaning on a horizontal bar. Ensure the top 20% and right 30% of the frame have dark negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary title in a bold, ultra-condensed red serif at the top. Add the secondary title as stacked, pale yellow handwritten script on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the background dark and industrial?
Is there a clear contrast between the formal header and the messy script?
Does the subject have 90s-style textured clothing?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Verify the 'wet' look of the industrial background
Ensure the script text looks hand-scrawled, not typed
Confirm the red color is vibrant against the dark background
recipe.reuseFormula: 90s country-rock portrait + [Subject Description] + [Industrial Setting] + Condensed Red Serif Header + Yellow Brush Script Subtitle
